data.one_liner: Periodic background callbacks and task scheduling for iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Attempts to awaken an app in the background approximately every 15 minutes to execute a provided callback function. It includes an Android Headless implementation for handling events post-app-termination and supports scheduling arbitrary one-shot or periodic tasks.
use_when: You need to periodically execute short tasks in the background on iOS and Android
You need an Android Headless implementation to handle events after app termination
You want to schedule arbitrary one-shot or periodic background tasks
avoid_when: You require exact-timing background execution faster than every 15 minutes
You need reliable background event termination handling on iOS (iOS does not support stopOnTerminate: false)
You are relying on immediate background execution on iOS without Apple's machine learning algorithm settling in
strengths: Provides background fetch functionality across both iOS and Android platforms
Includes Android Headless task implementation for handling events after app termination
Supports scheduling arbitrary one-shot or periodic tasks via scheduleTask
weaknesses: Event frequency is throttled by the operating system and cannot be set faster than 15 minutes
iOS stops firing events when the app is terminated (`stopOnTerminate: false` is not supported on iOS)
iOS can take days to begin regularly firing events based on Apple's machine-learning algorithm
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific setup guides for both iOS and Android as documented on the Transistor Software documentation site.
